<infobox theme="group">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>
        <data source="type"><label>Type of group</label></data>
        <data source="leader"><label>Leader(s)</label></data>
        <data source="subgroup"><label>Sub-group(s)</label></data>
        <data source="origin"><label>Origin</label></data>
        <data source="region"><label>Region(s)</label></data>
        <data source="species"><label>Species</label></data>
        <data source="language"><label>Language(s)</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Historical information</header>
        <data source="established"><label>Date established</label></data>	
        <data source="reorganized"><label>Date reorganized</label></data>
        <data source="dissolved"><label>Date dissolved</label></data>        
        <data source="restored"><label>Date restored</label></data>	
    </group>
        <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Other information</header>
    	<data source="distinctions"><label>Distinctions</label></data>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:CulturalGroup|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
